d:
Shaggy, chestnut brown hair with unruly spikes and long bangs. Warm honey-colored eyes with a gentle, naive expression. Appears as a late adolescent with a soft, youthful face. Lean and lithe build. Wears a simple tan tunic with brown leather straps and a green scarf. Features large, fluffy brown wolf ears protruding from the head and a long, bushy brown wolf tail.
BODY COLOR: tan
